rationale: This mutation bridges the -$10,999 cash deficit by synchronizing early plot expansion (8-10 plots by Day 6, 15-16 plots by Day 12) with workforce scaling (10-11 hands max) to unlock 4-5 hyper-fertilized Strawberry harvest flushes before a strict Day 22 procurement cutoff. It eliminates margin surrender by establishing an unyielding 0.82x liquidation price floor (0.88x scheduled batches), desensitizing Oracle front-running to risk >= 0.52, and duration-gating Town Shop seed purchases (day + growth <= 28; no slow crops after Day 17). Finally, it integrates in-situ harvest-and-water sequencing to prevent recurring crop regrowth pauses and purges phantom wheat reserves by setting livestock feed strictly to n_animals * 3.
